premises: A single-phase FCC matrix in HEAs provides high toughness by absorbing deformation energy effectively.
Slight increases in annealing temperature above an optimum can lead to nucleation of brittle intermetallic precipitates.
These brittle precipitates form at grain boundaries or within grains.
The precipitates act as crack initiation sites and stress concentration points, reducing toughness.
